# Synthetic anti-bot corpus (AC-18, AC-19)

Generator: `libs/go/antibot/corpus` (`corpus.Generate(corpus.DefaultSeed)`), deterministic, regenerated by
the tests. It does not import the engine. Every human parameter below was set from the source given, **before**
looking at the rule thresholds, and is not tuned to them. The corpus is a regression check, not proof of a low
false-positive rate. The real gate is the shadow demotion rate on real traffic (spec D8, AC-20).

## Humans (5000 sessions)

| Parameter | Value | Source / reasoning |
|---|---|---|
| Arrival after T0 | 70% exponential (mean 8 s), 30% uniform over 4 min | opening-spike shape of `tests/load/opening-spike.js` and docs/04 E8 (most buyers arrive in the first seconds) |
| Waited on the event page before T0 | 70%; `rt` uniform 5 s .. 15 min | buyers open the page before the countdown ends (countdown UI, BR-O2) |
| Late arrival `rt` | log-normal, median 2.6 s, sigma 0.8 | visual search + pointing time; Card, Moran & Newell (1983) and Fitts' law studies put a targeted click at 1-3 s after the page is visible |
| "Fast clicker" `rt` | 3% of late arrivals; log-normal median 170 ms, sigma 0.35 | pointer pre-positioned on the button; simple reaction time 150-250 ms (Card et al. 1983, ~240 ms; Welford 1980) |
| Discrete events before click | count exponential (mean 10) | browsing the event page before joining |
| Inter-event gap | log-normal median 420 ms, sigma 0.9 | human inter-action intervals are heavy-tailed (keystroke dynamics literature reports CV well above 0.5) |
| Key auto-repeat | 0.5% of desktop users hold Enter on the focused (still disabled) button until T0: 20-40 keydowns at 30-35 ms, the join fired by one more repeat | OS keyboard repeat rate ~30/s (Windows default); plan review round 2 P-2 residual |
| Keyboard-only | 2% of desktop users (Enter on the button) | assistive technology users (WebAIM screen-reader survey shares) |
| Mobile | 62% | share of mobile web traffic in Vietnam (StatCounter 2024-2025) |
| Privacy-hardened browser | 5%: WebGL off 50%, few fonts, 30% report UTC | Brave + Firefox resistFingerprinting + Tor shares |
| Zone / offset disagreement | 0.4% | time-zone spoofing extensions |
| Desktop fonts detected | normal(11, 2.5) of 20 | common fonts shipped by Windows / macOS |
| Mobile fonts detected | normal(3, 1.5) of 20 | mobile OSes ship few desktop fonts |
| IPv6 | 20% | Vietnam IPv6 adoption (Google IPv6 statistics, ~50% of which on mobile) |
| Re-join | 10%, 1-3 extra joins, 2 s + exp(30 s) apart | token expiry / second tab; idempotent re-join (BR-Q3) |
| Carrier NAT / campus | 2 clusters of 40 humans on one /24 within 5 min | contracts 8.3 hard case (carrier CGNAT, university network) |
| Household sharing one device | 3% of humans; size 2 (80%), 3 (15%), 4 (5%) | family members buying on one phone / PC; household size data (GSO Vietnam 2019 census, average 3.5 persons) |

Populations on both sides of each threshold are expected from these distributions and are asserted by the
test (fast clickers below and above `R2_MS`, auto-repeat below `R1_CLIENT_CV`, households above and below
`R4D_MAX`, clusters above `R4N_MAX`, privacy browsers below `R5_FONTS_MIN` and with WebGL off). Rules a human
cannot reach by construction (R1-server needs >= 4 joins without a slot; R6 dormant; R7 needs a shared digest)
are reported as such.

## Bots

| Family | Sessions | Behaviour | Expected (contracts 3) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw_http` | 200 | HTTP client UA, no signals (`{}` or absent), retries | R3+R5 → BLOCK |
| `headless` | 200 | `wd` true, scripted click (pe 1), `rt` 20-110 ms; 40% with patched UA | R2+R5 → BLOCK |
| `stealth_rhythm` | 200 | fixed ~100 ms rhythm, fast click | R1+R2 → SLOW_LANE |
| `account_farm` | 200 | 4 machines (shared fp), two /24s, human-like signals | R4D (+R4N) → SLOW_LANE; first 3 per device pass |
| `replay_proxy_pool` | 200 | one recorded session replayed, one datacenter /24 | R7+R4N → SLOW_LANE; first identities pass |
| `replay_residential` | 50 | same replay over distinct networks | R7 only → CHALLENGE → pass; informational, needs EV-176 |

## Not in this corpus

The 50-100 sessions recorded by the team with the real collector (AC-18) are a separate fixture
(`testdata/corpus/recorded/*.json`, one snapshot per file, to be added by the team); `corpus_test.go` asserts
< 1% demoted for them when the folder is non-empty.
